name: Close a member account with a zero balance
goal: Look up the member by member number and open their profile to confirm the account with the given account_no is present and its balance is $0.00. There is no on-page link to close a specific account, so navigate directly to the close-account screen for this member and this account_no (the URL follows the pattern /member/{member_id}/accounts/{account_no}/close). Confirm the account's balance shown there is $0.00, then click Close Account. Read back the account number shown on the resulting confirmation screen.

inputs.name: account_no
inputs.description: Exact zero-balance account number to close.

outputs.name: closed_account_no
outputs.description: The account number confirmed as closed.

business_outcomes.description: The member number does not exist.
The account cannot be closed because it does not have a zero balance -- a legitimate business-rule rejection.

known_interstitials.description: Host-maintenance session notice that occasionally interrupts navigation.
